figure.title: Verified cross-system relationships
figure.description: Every row is one implementation relationship recorded in the public system registry. Systems repeat when they participate in more than one relationship.
figure.claim: 18 implementation relationships are backed by the evidence IDs on their registry records. The map does not infer family, ownership, or general-association lines.
figure.doesNotProve: A recorded relationship does not establish product ownership, general interoperability, production adoption, performance, correctness, safety, or independent review.
figure.units: registry systems and verified typed relationship records
transformations: Only verified-in-source typed relation records are included.
Systems with no typed relationship are omitted from this relationship view.
Rows are sorted by source name, relationship type, and target name.
figure.uncertainty: The registry is a checked snapshot. Local source or a public release can change after its recorded verification date.

edges.claimScope: Flywheel 1.0.4 declares and launches Articulate as an authoring MCP lane, pinned to articulate-writing 0.4.0, with articulate-mcp as its declared command and articulate.local_mcp as its declared module. Articulate installs from PyPI, is not among the ten lanes bundled from vendored source, and remains an independently published package. The pin trails the current 0.5.0 release, and this relation does not show that Flywheel was tested with 0.5.0.
edges.label: includes as a lane

edges.claimScope: Flywheel 1.0.4 declares and launches Crucible as its verification MCP lane, pinned to crucible-bench 1.2.0. That pin is inside the range of GHSA-49qx-cj4f-wfqv, fixed in 1.3.0, and this relation does not show that Flywheel was tested with 1.3.0. This does not make Crucible a Flywheel-owned product.
edges.label: includes as a lane

edges.claimScope: Flywheel 1.0.4 declares and launches Forum as its orchestration MCP lane, pinned to forum-engine 1.14.0. That pin is inside the range of one of the two Forum advisories listed on the Security page, and 1.15.1 and later are outside both; this relation does not show that Flywheel was tested with 1.15.1.
edges.label: includes as a lane

edges.claimScope: Flywheel 1.0.4 declares and launches Gather as its research-intake MCP lane, pinned to gather-engine 1.8.2. That pin is inside the ranges of the four Gather advisories listed on the Security page, and 1.9.1 and later are outside all four; this relation does not show that Flywheel was tested with 1.9.1. This does not make Gather a Flywheel-owned product.
edges.label: includes as a lane
